review_notes: I read the whole file. I compared it with Mathlib's GroupExtension.conjAct (Defs.lean), MulEquiv.abelianizationCongr (Abelianization/Defs.lean) and the quotient and lift API. The file builds on those existing pieces and does not redefine them. conjActAbelianization is E →* MulAut (Abelianization N), built from conjAct and abelianizationCongr. quotientConjActAbelianization is built from QuotientGroup.lift and quotientKerRightHomEquivRight. Searching Mathlib for MulAut (Abelianization ...), a MulAut-to-MulAut-abelianization functor, or any existing action of an extension's middle group or quotient on the kernel's abelianization found nothing. Nothing outside the target and its topological counterpart in this library uses these names. I found no competing parallel concept. The named definitions are useful specialisations with a fixed orientation. Any other possible issues fall outside this rubric (for example, standalone lemma duplication or proof shortening).
